'''Jayke Ball Vader Invades Jabba's Palace''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11511">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11511 Vader Invades Jabba's Palace], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 2 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11511/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11511/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018100817/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11511/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 2 November 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Vader Invades Jabba's Palace''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 SYCFA Ball DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Deck Uses SYCFA to Psych opponent, then goes to jabba's Palace or thier planet to kill

== Original post ==

'''Vader Invades Jabba's Palace'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' November 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Deck Uses SYCFA to Psych opponent, then goes to jabba's Palace or thier planet to kill

=== Strategy ===

I HAVE A TYPO, IT ISN'T 3 IMPERIAL ARREST ORDERS, IT IS SUPPOSED TP BE 3 IMPERIAL BARRIERS  Start by Pulling a DB, DS war room, and Rendilli if you started Mob. POints. If you got a Jabbas Palace, put it out and get audience chamber. Then next turn get a DB, and deploy some guys from RD with Power of the hut, or wait. its up to you. Get a vader and go hunting with you inperials. PLay Circle on ben, then nail anyone who is left. Go to space if you have to, but it isnt neccasary. Have fin with this one
